name: Nemesis
caption: An eight-foot, self-declared ancient monster who debuted by turning an opponent into a mouse and, months later, choke-slammed Fear through a table off the top rope to become the final IWF Heavyweight Champion on record.

name: CalcGirl
caption: A math-genius rookie out of the California State University system, lowered to the ring by cable for her debut, who became IWF Women's Champion by pinning Silicon Sally with a fast count from a guest referee, The RAGE.

tenures.source: the site's own roster/bio page and its own show text

name: The Grim Rapper
caption: A hip-hop-gimmick wrestler introduced ushering in "a new era" ahead of Halloween Holocaust, who became the final IWF Hardcore Champion on record by knocking out Fear with his own ghetto blaster.

tenures.source: the site's own roster/bio page and its own show text

name: Fear
caption: The site's dominant heel across its run: a chair-wielding, self-declared "meanest, baddest, most electrifying" former multi-time IWF Heavyweight and self-crowned Hardcore Champion who, after losing both titles in one night, returned as a washed-up, substance-addled co-commentator.

tenures.source: the site's own roster/bio page and its own show text

name: Rage / The RAGE
caption: The site's long-running face and multi-time IWF Champion, fired in a screwjob engineered by his own broadcast partner Max Rakkus, who returned to reveal he had secretly orchestrated the conspiracy that later cost Fear both of his titles.

tenures.source: the site's own roster/bio page and its own show text

name: Edward K. Gruberman
caption: The IWF's Owner/President and an occasional in-ring wrestler in his own right, who fires and rehires wrestlers on a whim and bribes a policeman with VIP tickets to keep a rival locked up.

tenures.source: the site's own roster/bio page and its own show text

name: Elder Joseph Samuel Young
caption: A missionary-gimmick wrestler on "a two year mission to kick some butt," who once hijacked the broadcast to deliver a mock Olympic report from Salt Lake City before crashing a bike down a bobsled run.

tenures.source: the site's own roster/bio page and its own show text

name: Hugh Velgameister
caption: A wrestler who, allied with Pain, avenged an earlier ambush by destroying The RAGE's car and the IWF Championship belt inside it, and later drove the ambulance carrying two injured rivals off ominously at his own wheel.

tenures.source: the site's own roster/bio page and its own show text

name: Larry
caption: An erratic wrestler from "Happy Acres" whose finishing move is billed as "Getting pinned," recruited by Fear as tag-team muscle against Rage and later a combatant in a flaming tables match against Fear himself.

tenures.source: the site's own roster/bio page and its own show text

name: Pain
caption: A masked giant billed from "Parts Unknown" who, with Hugh, ambushed Fear and Rage from underneath the ring and later helped crush Rage's car in a wrecking yard.

tenures.source: the site's own roster/bio page and its own show text

name: Phoebe
caption: A wrestler billed from the San Fernando Valley whose scheduled Butterscotch Pudding Match against Rosie was pre-empted when Rage crashed the broadcast.

tenures.source: the site's own roster/bio page and its own show text

name: Rosie
caption: A wrestler self-billed as "one bad ass senorita," scheduled for a Butterscotch Pudding Match against Phoebe with Silicon Sally as special guest referee.

tenures.source: the site's own roster/bio page and its own show text

name: Silicon Sally
caption: The IWF's Women's Champion before CalcGirl, a Silicon Valley-billed wrestler whose finisher is named "Suffocation by Silicon," who lost the title in a match marred by outside interference and a fast count.

tenures.source: the site's own roster/bio page and its own show text

name: The Blender
caption: A snake-toting wrestler from Northridge, California, who "dies" comically and repeatedly across the site's run -- turned into a mouse and eaten by his own snake in his debut match, then crushed again by a falling sign and by his own fireworks stunt.

tenures.source: the site's own roster/bio page and its own show text

name: J.J. Tough
caption: The IWF's lead play-by-play commentator throughout the site's run, a steel-chair partisan who calls the action opposite a rotating cast of color commentators.

tenures.source: the site's own roster/bio page and its own show text

name: Max Rakkus
caption: The IWF's color commentator turned Fear's manager, ultimately unmasked as the secret architect behind both Rage's firing and Fear's later loss of both championships in a single night.

tenures.source: the site's own roster/bio page and its own show text

name: Marv Wilson
caption: The IWF's ring announcer for its main events throughout the site's run.

tenures.source: the site's own roster/bio page and its own show text

name: (Blind) Willie Johnson
caption: The IWF's house referee, billed in-fiction as blind and prone to being knocked out or distracted mid-match.

name: Lisa
caption: A college-intern statistician hired to compile match data for the broadcast, put through a table by Fear soon after joining, who filled in afterward as J.J. Tough's temporary co-commentator.
